meta.title: Decision strategies - Session O
meta.note: Ranked on risk-adjusted, normalized wealth (per $100k NOI) from scripts/model.py. NOT a valuation: rent, basis, and price are blank (B02/B07/B09). Final selection requires P1 answers.

strategies.name: Sell now via Section 1031 exchange
strategies.summary: Market the remaining term + story now; defer gain into diversified replacement(s).
strategies.best_if: BOV-as-is is strong; owner wants concentration risk (R-17) eliminated.
strategies.watch: ULA cliff (R-08); replacement overpricing (R-10); Prop 13 reset (R-09).

strategies.name: Blend-and-extend 10-15 years, then sell with long term
strategies.summary: Trade a modest rent/TI package for a long, financeable term; sell into the deeper long-term NNN buyer pool.
strategies.when: Negotiate 2026-2027 while tenant still needs the site; sell 2029-2032.
strategies.best_if: Tenant coverage (Q-05) is healthy and extension rent >= in-place rent.
strategies.watch: Tenant credit (R-03); do not extend a weakening credit without guaranty/security.

strategies.name: Hold to expiry, then sell / re-tenant
strategies.summary: Collect rent to 2030-2035, then face vacant-possession pricing.
strategies.when: Only if P1 answers prove exceptional store coverage and land value.
strategies.best_if: Land residual (Q-04 zoning) exceeds leased-fee value - unproven today.
strategies.watch: Worst tail in model (R-01, R-02); deadline drift (SG-10).

strategies.name: Renew at expiry and keep holding
strategies.summary: Renegotiate at the tenant's maximum-leverage moment.
strategies.when: Decision deferred to expiry - not recommended as a plan.
strategies.best_if: Almost never as a primary plan; fallback only.
strategies.watch: R-01/R-03/R-12 concentration with no term protection.

strategies.name: Sell now, pay the tax (no exchange) - comparison baseline
strategies.summary: Full liquidity, full tax recognition; quantifies what 1031 deferral is worth once CPA supplies basis (Q-15).
strategies.when: If replacement universe is poor, paying tax can beat overpaying for deferral (R-10).
strategies.best_if: Low gain / high basis, or owner needs diversified liquid portfolio.
strategies.watch: Tax computation is blank until Q-15; never estimate it here.
